article.title: 迪士尼與Visa在亞太合作，香港樂園擬推持卡人禮遇
article.summary: 迪士尼與Visa宣布在亞太重點市場展開多年合作，涵蓋聯名卡、持卡人禮遇及聯合行銷。
highlights: Visa將為合作涵蓋的迪士尼Visa聯名卡提供獨家支付網路。
香港迪士尼擬為合資格持卡人提供提早入園及指定娛樂優先權。
article.why: 品牌可把粉絲體驗與持卡禮遇綁在一起，為聯名產品提供可具體預期的使用情境。
article.next_step: 聯名合作團隊可先列出發卡方、場地及驗證資格所需資料，供正式條款公布後逐項核對。
article.detail: 雙方公布的香港迪士尼構想還包括指定的角色見面體驗。Visa亦將出任在新加坡舉行的D23 Asia粉絲活動首席贊助商，合資格持卡人可望獲預售機會。聯盟的參與市場、資格及推出時間仍待公布。規劃類似合作時，團隊可先確定每項禮遇由哪個合作方負責驗證及兌換。
article.title_en: Disney and Visa strike Asia-Pacific alliance with planned Hong Kong park perks
article.summary_en: Disney and Visa announced a multi-year alliance covering co-branded cards, cardholder benefits and joint marketing in key Asia-Pacific markets.
highlights_en: Visa will be the exclusive payment network for the Disney Visa co-brand programs covered by the alliance.
Planned perks for eligible cardholders at Hong Kong Disneyland include early entry and priority access to select entertainment.
article.why_en: Brands can tie fan experiences to cardholder perks to give customers a concrete reason to use the co-branded product.
article.next_step_en: List issuer, venue and eligibility data requirements so each can be checked once the terms are announced.
article.detail_en: The companies also outlined dedicated character encounters at Hong Kong Disneyland. Visa will be presenting sponsor of the D23 Asia fan event in Singapore, where eligible cardholders are expected to get presale access. Participating markets, eligibility and launch timing are still pending. Teams designing similar programs can decide who will validate and redeem each perk before promoting it.
